purpose: Fixed development-set budget selection after removing the per-tool body token cap

selection.compression_formula: mean(1 - first_request.estimated_tokens / setup.untrimmed.estimated_tokens) over all 12 primary attempts
selection.required_measurements: All 12 attempts must have actual first requests and valid untrimmed estimates; missing measurements do not disappear from the selection criterion
selection.rule: Run every fixed candidate and retain every result. Choose the smallest input budget meeting both thresholds. If none qualifies, report no selected budget; do not expand the grid or retry only failures.

confirmation.budget: The selected input budget, frozen before new attempts
confirmation.rule: Report all 36 primary attempts and all 3 loss controls separately. A selection-stage success is not a confirmation success; if confirmation misses the thresholds, report failure without selecting another budget from these results.

legacy_setting.name: tool_output_tokens
legacy_setting.handling: Preserve the base protocol and dataset hashes verbatim; ignore this removed field only when constructing production settings, and record ignored_legacy_settings in the report.

fixed_controls: Original task prompts, initial repositories, long history and hidden graders
Model, output reserve, tool profile, memory flags, safety boundaries and action/turn budgets
All failed attempts, errors, requests and trace artifacts are retained
Budget overrides use input_N labels; they are never mislabeled as the original balanced condition
limitations: These are previously inspected development tasks, not an unseen generalization set.
Confirmation uses fresh model attempts on the same tasks; it does not make the tasks held out.
First-request local token compression is not total provider token savings or a guarantee of retained semantics.
The one-attempt candidate scores are development selection measurements; do not present them as Pass@3.
Higher-budget runs cannot establish the causal benefit of removing the per-tool cap; use the separate 6144-input comparison for that question.
